title: My Family
text:
My name is Ali. I live with my family in a small house in Ankara. My mother is a teacher and my father is a doctor.

We have a big kitchen. Every Sunday, we cook lunch together. My little sister likes to help my mother. We eat and talk a lot.

questions.text: What does the family do every Sunday?
How does Ali's family feel about spending time together?
Why is Ali's little sister probably happy in the kitchen?
options: She wants to leave the house
She is studying in the kitchen

vocabulary.definition: the people you live with, such as parents and children
the room in a house where food is cooked
the day of the week after Saturday
with another person or other people, not alone

paragraph_translations: Benim adım Ali. Ailemle Ankara'da küçük bir evde yaşıyorum. Annem öğretmen ve babam doktor.
Büyük bir mutfağımız var. Her pazar birlikte öğle yemeği pişiririz. Küçük kız kardeşim annemize yardım etmeyi sever. Çok yeriz ve çok konuşuruz.
